bill.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 155) to require States to permit unaffiliated voters to vote in primary elections for Federal office, and for other purposes.

aiDescription.summary: This resolution orders immediate House consideration of H.R.155, which would require States to allow unaffiliated voters in federal primaries. It prescribes House floor terms, waiving points of order, adopting a printed substitute, limiting debate to one hour equally divided, allowing one motion to recommit, and exempting Rule XIX(1)(c).

impact.summary: This resolution orders immediate consideration of H.R. 155, waives points of order, adopts Fitzpatrick’s substitute, limits debate to one hour, allows one motion to recommit, and suspends clause 1(c) of House Rule XIX. H.R. 155 would require States to let unaffiliated voters join Federal primaries.
